model.interpolation: Linear between 12/24/48/72-hour anchors; unavailable outside the tested 12–72-hour model-lead range
model.validation: Ten directly observed NOAA gauges; 2021-2024 fit, 2025 and Jan-Aug 2026 test. NOT universal.

pooledBacktest.highThresholdDefinition: Each station's training-period observed 99th percentile; counts repeat forecast cases, not storms

model.warning: Research-only. It increased high-water misses; estimated lower quartile is not site-calibrated and is not an exact ensemble-member percentile. Keep issued PETSS for maps and alerts.
